annotations.title: One strategy: tracked record and back-test

description: One Advanced Strategies record, labelled hypothetical: for a 2x strategy the real-days-only numbers first, then the tracked record (NAV, windows, drawdown, Sharpe), the back-test (and how much is simulated), the scorecard against its benchmark ETF, costs, turnover and the second-source check. The tracked record comes before the back-test, which never ranks. Takes a slug from strategy_list.
